WAYS TO WIN

multipliers.name: MULTIPLIER FEATURE
multipliers.behavior: This game features a multiplier feature that will multiply your win in the base game up to 100x. Each game round will randomly generate a symbol (displayed inside the OmNom logotype) from the base game reels. If this 'mystery' symbol matches a winning symbol, the multiplier spinner will start. The win on the symbol matching the mystery symbol will then be multiplied by up to 100 times.

modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: Get three FREE SPIN symbols to trigger the free spin feature with 8 free spins.
modes.effects:
Get three FREE SPIN symbols to trigger the free spin feature with 8 free spins. In this feature extra WILD symbols are added to the reels to dramatically increase the chance of winning.

The FREE SPIN symbol can land on the first three reels. The FREE SPINS symbol does not appear in the free spin feature.

ABOUT THE GAME

 This is a POCKETZ game, our series of pocket format mobile games! Om Nom has a 4x4 grid and a max feature win of 4800x. The main game features a multiplier feature that will multiply your win in the base game up to 100x. The free spin feature adds extra WILD symbols to the reels to dramatically increase the chance of winning.
